help_text:
PANDUAN FILE MANAGER & ARCHIVE BOT
Gunakake prentah ing ngisor iki kanggo ngelola panyimpenan:

• cd - Deleng folder bot / filemanager
• cd ~ utawa cd / - Langsung menyang Root Storage (/storage/emulated/0)
• cd <path> - Jelajahi folder tartamtu
• cd .. utawa back - Bali menyang folder sadurunge
• catfile <file> - Waca isi file teks
• mkdir <folder> - Nggawe folder anyar
• download <URL> [name] - Unduh file
• upload <file> - Kirim file menyang chat
• deletefile <file> - Busak file/folder
• renamefile <old> <new> - Ganti jeneng file/folder
• movefile <src> <dest> - Pindhah file/folder
• copyfile <src> <dest> - Salin file/folder

📦 PRENTAH ARSIP (ZIP / TAR):
• zip <target> [output.zip] - Kompres file/folder dadi ZIP
• unzip <file.zip> [dest_folder] - Ekstrak file ZIP
• tar <target> [output.tar.gz] - Kompres file dadi TAR.GZ
• untar <file.tar.gz> [dest_folder] - Ekstrak file TAR/TAR.GZ
catfile_prompt: Mangga lebokake jeneng file teks sing bakal diwaca.
download_url_scheme: URL kudu diwiwiti nganggo http:// utawa https://.
upload_prompt: Mangga lebokake jeneng file sing pengin diunggah.
upload_not_found: File ora ketemu utawa minangka direktori.
upload_no_plugin: Plugin upload (xep_0363) ora aktif ing bot.
delete_prompt: Mangga lebokake jeneng file sing bakal dibusak.
rename_wrong_format: Format salah. Conto: renamefile old.txt new.txt
zip_wrong_format: Format salah. Conto: zip my_folder my_archive.zip

unzip_not_found: File ZIP ora ketemu utawa dudu file ZIP sing bener.
tar_wrong_format: Format salah. Conto: tar my_folder backup.tar.gz
untar_not_found: File TAR ora ketemu utawa dudu arsip TAR sing bener.

err_binary: Iki berkas biner, ora bisa dituduhake minangka teks.
